options.name: --help
options.description: Print help information

options.name: --version
options.description: Print version information

options.name: --sort
options.description: [possible values: general-numeric, human-numeric, month, numeric, version

name: -h
--human-numeric-sort
options.description: Compare according to human readable sizes, eg 1M > 100k

name: -M
--month-sort
options.description: Compare according to month name abbreviation

name: -n
--numeric-sort
options.description: Compare according to string numerical value

name: -g
--general-numeric-sort
options.description: Compare according to string general numerical value

name: -V
--version-sort
options.description: Sort by SemVer version number, eg 1.12.2 > 1.1.2

name: -R
--random-sort
options.description: Shuffle in random order

options.name: --random-source
options.description: Use FILE as a source of random data

name: -d
--dictionary-order
options.description: Consider only blanks and alphanumeric characters

name: -m
--merge
options.description: Merge already sorted files

name: -c
--check
options.description: Check for sorted input

name: -C
--check-silent
options.description: Exit successfully if the given file is already sorted, and exit with status 1

name: -f
--ignore-case
options.description: Fold lower case to upper case characters

name: -i
--ignore-nonprinting
options.description: Ignore nonprinting characters

name: -b
--ignore-leading-blanks
options.description: Ignore leading blanks when finding sort keys in each line

name: -o
--output
options.description: Write output to FILENAME instead of stdout

name: -r
--reverse
options.description: Reverse the output

name: -s
--stable
options.description: Stabilize sort by disabling last-resort comparison

name: -u
--unique
options.description: Output only the first of an equal run

name: -k
--key
options.description: Sort by a key

name: -t
--field-separator
options.description: Custom separator for -k

name: -z
--zero-terminated
options.description: Line delimiter is NUL, not newline

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Change the number of threads running concurrently to NUM_THREADS

name: -S
--buffer-size
options.description: Sets the maximum SIZE of each segment in number of sorted items

name: -T
--temporary-directory
options.description: Use DIR for temporaries, not $TMPDIR or /tmp

options.name: --compress-program
options.description: Compress temporary files with PROG, decompress with PROG -d

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Merge at most N_MERGE inputs at once

options.name: --files0-from
options.description: Read input from the files specified by NUL-terminated NUL_FILE

options.name: --debug
options.description: Underline the parts of the line that are actually used for sorting
